summary: Diginex Limited, a London-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting that on October 8, 2026 shareholders approved, by roughly 98.8% of votes cast, its acquisition of all issued share capital of Resulticks Global Companies Pte. Limited under an Amended and Restated Sale and Purchase Agreement dated August 14, 2026. Consideration comprises 600,000,000 newly issued ordinary shares, subject to adjustment, issued to the sellers; the transaction also triggers a change of control and Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(b) approval. Turnout was 27,584,395 shares, or 55.026% of 50,130,130 outstanding. Watch closing conditions and resulting ownership dilution.
